title: 第19章 有这种好东西，还不拿出来！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 见到两个老者撸着袖子要干架，唐音立即搬着一个椅子跑到两人中间，眨着一双大眼睛道：“爷爷，我坐这里。”两个老头立即休战，各种好吃的都摆到了唐音的面前。“怎么？就我寂寂无名，让你行礼都不屑？”炎文帝有些不满，抬手敲了敲桌子。唐逸有些尴尬，道：“晚辈唐逸，还不知道大叔怎么称呼。”“我叫萧策！你可以叫我萧叔。”炎文帝直接报出自己名字。陈貂寺，赵虎脸色顿时都变了。陛下，你怎么连化名都不用，直接报出自己的真名啊！直接叫你的名讳，那可是大不敬。萧策？唐逸在脑海中搜索了一下这个名字，没有任何线索。他也就没有太在意，恭敬行礼：“见过萧叔，还得先谢萧叔了，要不是萧叔出手，估计现在唐家大门现在都被人踏平了。”唐逸不是傻子，《满江红》闹得这么大，惊动了满朝文武，想要查出他的身份轻而易举。但现在他诗仙的身份没人发现，只能说明有一股未知的力量干预了。而他认识的并且有这个实力的，就只有眼前这男人。“得感谢你自己，那天像个乞丐一样，没什么人认出你的身份，我才有操作空间。”炎文帝有些烦躁地挥了挥手，道：“今日不买诗，朕……真的很烦呢，已经决定要打了，但是北狄骑兵，已经吓破很多人的胆了。”“我想听听，你有没有对付北狄骑兵的法子！”唐逸指了指自己，愕然道：“萧叔，你是不是太看得起我了？这种事你怎么问我呢？狄老将军和老王爷都在这里呢。”“他们可是前辈，我哪敢在他们面前班门弄斧！”唐逸无语，再说这是国事。妄议这种事，搞不好是要掉脑袋的。“小子，朝廷已经决定要打了。”“但是，依旧有很多人反对，陛下为这事烦着呢。”狄苍给唐音剔掉鱼刺，将鱼肉放到唐音的碗中，道：“有什么话，你尽管说就是了，再说只是闲聊！”炎文帝也是瞪了唐逸一眼，道：“听到了吧？闲聊而已，你怕什么？”唐逸笑道：“那对付骑兵的话，当然是马克沁重机枪了！”炎文帝，狄苍齐齐抬起头：“马克……什么枪？”“咳咳，没啥，开个玩笑。”唐逸坐了下来，沉吟了一下道：“这个时代要对付骑兵，方法其实很多，譬如打造陌刀，钩镰枪，然后组织敢死队，下砍马腿，上挑骑兵！”“但这需要军队有很强的素质和勇气，咱们大炎的军队……说实话，做不到。”炎文帝想要反驳，话到嘴边成了一声轻叹。要是军队有这种素质，哪里还有靖康耻！“所以，只能在武器上下功夫。”“而对付骑兵最好的武器，就是弓弩。”“但咱们的弓射程太近，杀伤力也不够，往往射两拨就被骑兵贴脸了。”“但我知道一种弓箭……复合弓，杀伤力大，射程远，对付骑兵绰绰有余。还有诸葛连弩，能一次性发出十几支箭，可以和复合弓搭配使用。”唐逸侃侃而谈，狄苍和炎文帝相视一眼，眼中都有震惊。一直没说话的老王爷也抬起头，打量着唐逸。这小家伙说什么？他还真有办法对付骑兵啊！复合弓？诸葛连弩？这都什么武器？没听说过啊！啪！狄苍一把捏住唐逸的肩膀，道：“有这种好东西，还不赶紧拿出来？”“嘶！”唐逸只觉得肩膀都碎了，疼得直抽冷气：“老将军，你想要也得给我时间，让我把设计图画出来啊！”“你现在就要，我上哪里给你弄去。”炎文帝拍掉狄苍的手，道：“那就先画出来，刚好老王爷要出城巡查几天，画出来后让人送到老王爷手中，尽快让军中迅速打造出来。”“日夜赶工，先赶一批出来试试效果！”老王爷点点头，道：“只要图纸出来，这件事我亲自抓。”“只要能杀北狄狗，赔上我这条老命都可以！”老王爷脸上带着狠戾，狄苍抬手拍了拍他的肩膀，炎文帝也是轻叹了一口气。他们都是靖康耻的经历者，都有亲人死在那场劫难中。老王爷的妻儿就是在那场劫难中离世，那种绝望而羞辱的画面，他们不想再经历第二次！唐逸察觉到气氛凝重，只是不知道当年的事，只好保持沉默。唐音看到刚刚对自己和蔼的老人，现在满身的杀气，连忙将面前的烧鸡推到老王爷的面前。“爷爷你吃，爷爷不要死，要长命百岁。”她不知道仇恨，就算哥哥以前被大哥二哥欺负得半死，她也只是愤怒而已。但是，她对饥饿有着极度的恐惧。以为只要吃饱了，就不会死！一句话，让老王爷当场老泪纵横。如果没有那场该死的战争，他的儿子不战死，他孙女应该也是这般大了吧！“好，爷爷吃，爷爷也不会死。”老王爷亲手掰下一根鸡腿给唐音，自己撕下一根鸡翅塞进嘴里道：“爷爷要活着，看着我大炎男儿，血洗当年之耻！”炎文帝闻言脸色有些黯然，他何尝不想雪耻呢？但当年那一战，已经将大炎的脊梁打折了，以至于很多人以为跪着生，就可以不用死了。可是他们忘记了，他是皇帝，大炎的皇帝。他不是傀儡！“梁叔，既然是闲聊，那有些话我就直说了。”唐逸由于前世的职业习惯，这几日从唐敬的书房中拿了不少的资料和舆图，大概了解了北境的局势。“这几日闲着无聊，我研究了一下北狄和咱们打过的仗”“发现他们对大炎发起战争，大多都是为了掠夺过冬物资，大部分是在大炎秋收时开战，少部分则是冬季过不下去的时候才开战。”“可现在咱大炎秋收过去一个多月了，他们还只是陈兵边境，并没有开战的迹象，这不合理……”“要说他们想等到冬季再开战，那现在集结几十万兵马等几个月？人吃马嚼都得好死他北狄，更不合理……”“我觉得，北狄可能是和东虞联手，企图分割北境了。”
content_en: Seeing the two old men rolling up their sleeves and about to fight, Tang Yin immediately moved a chair and ran between them, blinked his big eyes and said, "Grandpa, I'll sit here." The two old men immediately made a truce, and all kinds of delicious food were placed in front of Tang Yin."What? I am so unknown that you don't even bother to salute me?" Emperor Yan Wen was a little dissatisfied and raised his hand to knock on the table.Tang Yi was a little embarrassed and said: "Junior Tang Yi, I still don't know what to call uncle." "My name is Xiao Ce! You can call me Uncle Xiao." Emperor Yan Wen directly reported his name.Chen Diao Temple and Zhao Hu's expressions suddenly changed.Your Majesty, why didn't you even use a pseudonym and just reported your real name?Calling you by your first name would be disrespectful.Xiao Ce?Tang Yi searched for this name in his mind, but there was no clue.He didn't pay much attention and saluted respectfully: "I have met Uncle Xiao, so I have to thank Uncle Xiao first. If Uncle Xiao hadn't taken action, the Tang family's gate would have been trampled down by now." Tang Yi was not a fool. "Man Jiang Hong" made such a big fuss that it alerted the civil and military officials of the entire court, and it was easy to find out his identity.But now no one has discovered his identity as Shixian, which can only mean that an unknown force intervened.And the only person he knew who had this strength was the man in front of him."You have to thank yourself. You were like a beggar that day. No one recognized your identity, so I had room to operate." Emperor Yan Wen waved his hands a little irritably and said: "I don't want to buy poems today. I... am really annoyed. I have decided to fight, but the Beidi cavalry has scared many people out of their courage." "I want to hear,Do you have any way to deal with the Beidi cavalry?" Tang Yi pointed at himself and said in surprise: "Uncle Xiao, do you think too highly of me?How can you ask me about this?General Di and the old prince are both here.How dare I do anything in front of them?" Tang Yi was speechless. Besides, this is a state matter.If you discuss this kind of thing arbitrarily, you may lose your head."Boy, the court has decided to fight." "However, there are still many people who oppose it. Your Majesty is troubled by this matter." Di Cang removed the fish bones for Tang Yin, put the fish meat into Tang Yin's bowl, and said, "If you have anything to say, just say it.Yes, it's just chatting!" Emperor Yan Wen also glared at Tang Yi and said, "You heard it?It's just chatting, what are you afraid of?" Tang Yi said with a smile: "Then it's the Maxim heavy machine gun!Cang Qiqi raised his head: "Mark... what kind of gun?" "Ahem, it's nothing, just kidding." Tang Yi sat down, pondered for a while and said: "In this era, there are actually many ways to deal with cavalry, such as making swords and hooks, and then organizing death squads to chop off horse legs and pick up cavalry!" "But this requires the army to have strong quality and courage. Our Dayan army... To be honest, we can't do that." Emperor Yan Wen wanted to refute, but the words turned into a sigh.If the army had this kind of quality, how could there be any shame in Jingkang!"So, we can only work hard on weapons." "The best weapon to deal with cavalry is crossbows." "But our bows have a too short range and are not lethal enough. We often shoot two rounds before being killed by cavalry." "But I know a kind of bow and arrow...The compound bow has high lethality and a long range, which is more than enough to deal with cavalry.There is also the Zhuge Liannu, which can fire more than a dozen arrows at one time and can be used in conjunction with the compound bow." As Tang Yi talked, Di Cang and Emperor Yanwen looked at each other with shock in their eyes.The old prince who had been silent also raised his head and looked at Tang Yi.What did this little guy say?He really has a way to deal with the cavalry!Compound bow?Zhuge Liannu?What kind of weapons are these?Never heard of it!Snap!Di Cang pinched Tang Yi's shoulder and said, "You have such a good thing, why don't you take it out quickly?" "Hiss!" Tang Yi felt his shoulder was broken and gasped in pain: "Old General, if you want it, you have to give me time to draw the design!" "You want it now, I can get it for you somewhere." Emperor Yanwen swatted Di Cang's hand away and said, "Then draw it first, it just so happens that the old prince is going out of the city for inspection.God, after the drawings are made, they will be sent to the old prince and the army will build them as soon as possible." "Work hard day and night, get out a batch first and try out the effect!" The old prince nodded and said, "As long as the drawings come out, I will take care of this matter myself." The old prince had a cruel look on his face, Di Cang raised his hand and patted his shoulder, and Emperor Yan Wen also sighed.They all experienced the humiliation of Jingkang, and all of them had relatives who died in that disaster.The old prince's wife and children died in that disaster. They didn't want to experience that kind of despair and humiliation again!Tang Yi noticed that the atmosphere was solemn, but he didn't know what happened back then, so he had to remain silent.Tang Yin saw that the old man who had just been kind to him was now full of murderous intent, and he quickly pushed the roast chicken in front of the old prince."Grandpa, you eat. Grandpa doesn't want to die. He wants to live a long life." She didn't know hatred. Even if her brother was bullied to death by the eldest and second brothers before, she was just angry.However, she has an extreme fear of hunger.I thought that as long as I was full, I would not die!One sentence made the old prince burst into tears on the spot.If there hadn't been that damn war and his son hadn't died fighting, his granddaughter would have been this old!"Okay, if grandpa eats it, grandpa won't die." The old prince broke off a chicken leg with his own hands and gave it to Tang Yin. He tore off a chicken wing and stuffed it into his mouth and said, "Grandpa will live and watch my great Yan man wash away the shame of the past!" Emperor Yanwen's face became a little sad when he heard this. Why didn't he want to avenge his shame?But that battle that year had already fractured Dayan's spine, so much so that many people thought that by living on their knees, they would not have to die.But they forgot that he was the emperor, the emperor of Dayan.He is not a puppet!"Uncle Liang, since it's just a small talk, I'll tell you some things directly." Due to his professional habits in his previous life, Tang Yi took a lot of information and maps from Tang Jing's study in the past few days, and roughly understood the situation in the northern border."I've been bored these past few days, so I studied the battles we fought in Beidi." "I found that most of the wars they waged against Great Yan were to plunder winter supplies. Most of them started the war during the Great Yan's Autumn Harvest, and a few started the war when the Winter was unbearable." "But now it's been more than a month since our Great Yan Autumn Harvest, and they are still just on the border with troops, and there is no sign of war. This is unreasonable..." "It's unreasonable to say that they want to wait until winter.
title_en: Chapter 19 There is such a good thing, but you still don’t take it out!
